superiority: At least21/31 paired whole-process wins and upper95% two-sided bootstrap median relative-change interval below0 versus BOTH fixed IR242 and matched parent IR264.
other_boundary: Post-JSON one-sided95% upper median paired relative-change bound <=1% versus fixed IR242. No accumulated concessions.
practical_restore_threshold: At least10% restoration-instruction reduction or1ms restoration reduction versus matched parent, independently measured; no deferral to first evaluation.
confirmation: If the first cohort passes, declare a second independently seeded confirmation before rerunning; rejected unchanged candidates are not rerun for a favorable result.
goal: Parity with fastest eligible measured Rust at BOTH boundaries; a phase improvement does not complete the goal.
